decisions.reason: As a 2023 line extension that remained on the website in 2024 and builds on the firm’s established spraying business, it is a low-cost option to keep open while market uptake continues to become clearer.

The product still had its own page in 2024 and has at least some field-testing reference, so for a medium-sized German machinery producer it is sensible to continue this close-to-core option rather than exit early.

Because it reuses proven air-motor technology and stayed on the website in 2024, the firm can maintain this adjacent product at relatively low cost while preserving upside in its existing customer base.

Fire protection flow monitoring remained prominently presented in 2024 and fits the firm’s move toward more future-oriented, interoperable solutions, so the option value of keeping it is high relative to the likely cost.

Since this hydraulic two-component spraying system was only launched in 2024 and is close to the established offer, uncertainty has not resolved enough to justify abandonment and the firm should give the option more time.
